title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company. We stream 650\+ Bengali movies, 185\+ originals, and 3000\+ hours of content to a global audience of \~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100\+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI\-led micro\-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI\-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product \& Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.
 



  





 This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Kolkata.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Drop\-off Analysis** 



* Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
* Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
* For every drop\-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
* Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
* Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.



**Retention, Churn \& Cohorts** 



* Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day\-1/7/30, trial\-to\-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
* Identify first\-session and first\-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.



**Content \& Programming Analytics** 



* Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop\-off curves, and search behaviour.
* Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
* Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.



**Experimentation** 



* Set up and read A/B tests and feature\-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
* Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.



**Reporting Rhythm** 



* Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
* Deliver release\-impact analysis after every major app release.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications :** 



* 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
* Hands\-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
* Demonstrated ability to find drop\-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
* Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
* Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
* Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
* Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
* Self\-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.



  





  





**Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar.** 




  





**Why Join hoichoi** 




 You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all\-in on becoming AI\-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.
 



  





**Culture \& How We Work** 




 At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross\-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.
 



  





 We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
**Department** 
 : Rare Disease \& Public Care
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – EY Comply: Position: Manager**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are looking for a skilled Regulatory Reporting Professional to drive end\-to\-end delivery of regulatory reporting solutions and reporting transformation initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with global stakeholders to design, implement, and optimise regulatory reporting processes, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements while enhancing data quality, controls, and operational efficiency across reporting frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership: Manage and mentor cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality, high\-integrity solutions while building a mature practice and driving a culture of accountability and operational excellence.
* Regulatory Delivery \& Governance: Lead end\-to\-end execution and sign\-off for U.S. and global regulatory filings (including MTL, capital adequacy, liquidity, ICAAP, and balance sheet reporting).
* Licensing Strategy \& Framework Setup: Assess new licensing requirements across jurisdictions and design end\-to\-end reporting frameworks, templates, and operational processes from scratch.
* Control Architecture \& Audit Readiness: Enforce maker\-checker protocols, robust audit trails, and sign\-off governance to maintain continuous audit readiness and mitigate operational risk across all reporting lines.
* Process Automation \& Platform Scalability: Spearhead process optimization and automation using SQL, Python, and modern data platforms to eliminate manual effort, standardize workflows, and improve scalability.
* Business Alignment: Partner with business leaders to translate strategic requirements into scalable platform solutions and drive agile delivery for existing and new offerings.
* AI \& Advanced Analytics Fluency: Institutionalize responsible AI adoption and advanced analytics to automate anomaly detection, exception handling, and regulatory commentary generation.
* SLA \& Performance Monitoring: Track key performance indicators (KPIs), service level agreements (SLAs), and reporting timelines to sustain high delivery precision across all client engagements.
* Global Stakeholder Management: Partner with U.S. and global leadership, managing cross\-border delivery models and cross\-functional partner relationships.
* Time\-Zone Flexibility \& Coverage: Operate with time\-zone agility to ensure seamless hand\-offs with international stakeholders and meet strict global submission windows
* Al fluency \- Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 8–10\+ years of progressive experience in regulatory reporting or financial services.
* 3–5\+ years successfully leading cross\-functional teams and managing practice delivery.
* Deep domain understanding of U.S. and global filings, including MTL, capital adequacy, liquidity, ICAAP, and balance sheet reporting.
* Proven ability to assess new jurisdictional licensing requirements and design reporting frameworks from scratch.
* Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field (CPA, CA, CFA, or MBA strongly preferred).
* Track record of establishing maker\-checker protocols, robust audit trails, and risk management frameworks to maintain continuous audit readiness.
* Strategic ability to drive end\-to\-end process automation and leverage SQL, Python, Snowflake, or Looker to modernize legacy platforms.
* Practical focus on institutionalizing responsible AI tools and advanced analytics for exception handling, anomaly detection, and commentary generation.
* Ability to translate complex regulatory mandates into actionable business requirements (BRDs) and bridge business units with system architects.
* Superior written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to interface with senior leadership, product teams, and engineers.
* Proven capability managing onshore/offshore cross\-border delivery models with time\-zone flexibility to support extended global submission windows.


**\< What we look for\>\>**
 We are looking for a professional with strong Reporting knowledge, excellent analytical \& communication skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, demonstrates ownership and consistently delivers high\-quality work while meeting deadlines
   

  

 What we offer you
   

  

 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment** 
 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* Utilizing Alteryx for automation and data processing
* Developing solutions with Python and R programming languages
* Applying data visualization techniques using Microsoft Power BI
* Analyzing financial risks with advanced analytical tools
* Engaging in business process improvement initiatives
* Demonstrating proficiency in data wrangling and analysis
* Excelling in active listening and communication skills

title: Campaign Performance Executive - Dialler Operation
description:
**About the role** 




 Primo Dialler is a UK\-based telecommunications company providing VoIP, dialler, connectivity and cloud communication services. We work with outsourced call centres running outbound sales campaigns across the UK and USA. We are looking for a hands\-on Campaign Performance Executive to support campaign operations, monitor performance, review calls and follow up with call centre supervisors.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Set up and monitor outbound campaigns, agent access and campaign settings.
 



 • Upload and manage lead data, callbacks, dispositions and campaign activity.
 



 • Monitor agent logins, dials, contacts, talk time, sales and conversion performance.
 



 • Listen to sales and non\-sales calls every day and record clear quality feedback.
 



 • Identify poor\-quality calls, weak sales behaviour and potential compliance concerns.
 



 • Identify underperforming agents and centres and follow up with supervisors.
 



 • Monitor data usage and flag unusual lead or disposition patterns.
 



 • Prepare clear daily performance reports showing results, issues and actions taken.
 



 • Escalate serious technical, quality or performance issues to management.
 



  





**Required Skills** 




 • 1\-3 years of experience in outbound call centre, BPO, QA, dialler or campaign operations.
 



 • Good understanding of outbound sales campaigns and common call centre KPIs.
 



 • Comfortable listening to and reviewing sales calls.
 



 • Good Excel or Google Sheets skills and strong attention to detail.
 



 • Good written and spoken English.
 



 • Comfortable communicating with call centre supervisors and managers.
 



 • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and tasks.
 



 • Flexible to work rotational shifts covering UK and US campaign hours.
 



  





**Preferred Experience** 




 Experience with UK or US outbound campaigns, telecoms, VoIP, call quality monitoring, sales reporting, lead management or CRM systems would be beneficial.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 We want someone who does more than report numbers. If sales drop, data is being wasted or call quality is poor, you should investigate, identify the issue, follow up with the centre and report the outcome to management.

title: Ethical Sourcing Executive - Kolkata, India
description:
**Application Deadline:** 
 24 March 2023
 



**Department:** 
 Social Impact \& Sustainability
 



**Location:** 
 India
 



**Compensation:** 
 Rs1,000,000 \- Rs1,200,000 / year
   

  




**Description**
*Great People Work Here*
 Are you searching for a career with bags of variety, in an environment that celebrates differences and empowers collaboration, which values individuals and will encourage you to make an impact? Do you want the freedom to explore, and the opportunities to find new ways and to innovate? If so, TwiningsOvo delivers.
   

  

 We’re looking for people who don’t just come here to get the job done, but who have a real passion for the brand and a desire to do the best job they can. In return, we offer an inspiring package of employee benefits \- to show just how much we value you. This role will offer you the scope for growth and the tools to aim high.
   

  

 The Ethical Sourcing Executive is part of the Global Social Impact and Sustainability team and will provide support to the Senior Social Impact Manager (based Kolkata) in assessing and driving improvements of working and living conditions for communities in Twinings’ agricultural supply chain, primarily tea in the region (India, Sri Lanka, and Indonesia).
   

  

 This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to Twinings ambitious Sourced with Care programme and drive tangible, positive and sustainable impact in its supply chain in the region. The role focuses on issues above and beyond the ones traditionally covered by social audits and have a specific focus on by assessing conditions, driving improvements, and supporting the day\-to\-day implementation of tailored projects to improve the quality of life in sourcing communities, including gender, living conditions, livelihoods, health, and nutrition.
   

  

 This opportunity would fit an ambitious and driven candidate with technical expertise looking to develop their ability to influence key stakeholders in the supply chain and broaden their knowledge of ethical and responsible supply chain. If you have the experience and drive to develop within ethical sourcing management, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Monitoring and improvements** 
* Organise and conduct needs assessments in sourcing communities in the region against the social criteria defined in the assessment tools (TCNA) by engaging with local communities and relevant stakeholders to identify their needs, priorities in a participatory manner.
* Prepare detailed assessment reports, including scoring and substantiated with evidence to provide clear information to Twinings and producers.
* Identify all key potential social and environmental impacts and risks existing in the system and ensure that their magnitude and significance are understood by the internal stakeholders. Work with Twinings Senior Social Impact Manager and producer groups to agree improvement plan and next actions and keep the internal stakeholders updated.
* Follow up on the progress of suppliers’ improvements against the action plan in a timely manner.
* Build supply chain knowledge in the region (eg: mapping smallholders).


**Projects** 
* Support the day\-to\-day implementation and monitoring of projects in the region.
* Identify needs and support the development and rollout of training/support programme for sites/producers.
* Support global projects or advise on issues across the supply chain (for example on GBV, health and wellbeing, carbon footprint etc.).


**Stakeholders’ engagement** 
* Work with the Senior SI Manager to develop networks with key stakeholders inside and outside the industry and engage in constructive dialogue, to progress the SI\&S agenda and drive change in our supply chain.
* Participating, as required, in relevant industry bodies, acting as Twinings representative.
* Keep up to date on current industry SI\&S initiatives and best practices.


**Communication and reporting / M\&E** 
* Working with partners and producers to track Sourced with Care KPIs in a timely, effective, and accurate manner, and help measure our impact (including financial resilience and women’s empowerment).
* Reporting on sites ethical performances to internal stakeholders (Head of Social Impact, Senior leadership, buyers)
* Contribute to good quality content gathering and comms activities (case studies, pictures, videos, articles, etc.)
* Effective use of the Twinings Ethical database and other tools to track and analyse records of conditions on tea estates and agreed KPIs.
* Provide additional support as needed for reporting activities.


**Team support** 
* Support with general administrative tasks as well as team systems and processes.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, as needed (internal presentation, newsletter article, employees field visit, etc).


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
* A passion for engaging with local communities and driving social change in the agriculture supply chain.
* Previous experience of conducting Community\-based participatory research or needs assessments
* Strong communication skills – verbal and written (fluent in English) including strong presentation skills.
* Ability to establish and manage effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Understanding of human rights, labour rights, UN SDGs, gender issues and ethical sourcing.
* Ability to travel up to 60% of the time (domestic and international), sometimes with basic facilities.
* Up to date knowledge and good command of MS Office (word, excel and power point are must)
* Degree level in the social or development studies, environment, agriculture or in relevant discipline.
* Enthusiastic individual, able to work autonomously as well as being a team player.
* Resourceful and solution\-orientated mind\-set.
* Ability to work independently, work under pressure and to be able to organise own work schedule
* Some Knowledge of the agriculture supply chain and issues related to responsible sourcing in any of the countries in the region.
* At least 2 years’ intensive experience in the relevant fields.
* Sound understanding of ethical issues related to the supply chain, practices and regulations in Sri Lanka, Indonesia and/or India context.
* Knowledge of other languages: Tamil, Bahasa Indonesia, or Hindi.
* Prior experience in human rights, development sector, climate, or sustainability.
* Demonstrate pro\-activeness, an enquiring mind and encourages new ideas.
* Demonstrate teamwork capabilities including in cross functional and international teams.

description:
**Job Description**
**Manager – Financial Transactions Transfer Pricing (FTTP)**
 The Financial Transactions Transfer Pricing (FTTP) Manager will be responsible for leading and delivering transfer pricing engagements related to intercompany financial transactions, including loans, guarantees, cash pooling, and treasury arrangements. The role requires strong technical expertise, global transfer pricing knowledge, entrepreneurial mindset, and the ability to drive high‑quality client engagements across geographies.
   

  

 \#KGS
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end FTTP engagements, including planning, execution, review, and delivery
* Manage transfer pricing analysis for intercompany loans, guarantees, cash pooling, hedging, and treasury structures
* Apply and interpret global transfer pricing regulations, OECD guidelines, BEPS actions, and local country rules
* Develop and review economic and financial models (e.g., credit rating, pricing of guarantees, interest benchmarking)
* Ensure high quality and technical accuracy of all deliverables, including reports, documentation, and client presentations
* Act as a key point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders across multiple geographies
* Drive engagements independently, manage timelines, and proactively identify risks and improvement areas
* Collaborate with tax, treasury, and finance teams to design practical and defensible solutions
* Support business development through proposal support, opportunity identification, and thought leadership
* Mentor and review work of junior team members, contributing to team capability building


 \#KGS
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Financial Transactions Transfer Pricing (FTTP)
* Hands\-on experience with transfer pricing for financial transactions in a Big 4, consulting firm, or multinational environment
* Proven experience handling cross\-border stakeholders and global projects
* Strong understanding of global TP regulations, OECD transfer pricing guidelines, and country\-specific rules


**Technical Skills \& Knowledge**
* Deep expertise in FTTP concepts, including:
+ Intercompany loans and guarantees
+ Cash pooling and treasury structures
+ Credit rating and financial risk analysis
+ Interest rate benchmarking and economic analysis

* Strong analytical and quantitative skills
* Ability to interpret financial statements and treasury data
* Proficiency in Excel and financial modeling
* Proficiency in FTTP databases.


 \#KGS

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a skilled Regulatory Reporting Professional to drive end\-to\-end delivery of regulatory reporting solutions and reporting transformation initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with global stakeholders to design, implement, and optimise regulatory reporting processes, ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory requirements while enhancing data quality, controls, and operational efficiency across reporting frameworks.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Work as senior on multiple workstreams or clients as a part of Regulatory Reporting BAU/Production team.

* Work independently with minimum supervision.
* Provide technical guidance to the team as well as clients as needed.
* The role is deadline oriented and may require working under US time schedule.
* Be involved in project management as needed.
* Mentor, train and inspire staff to meet the project objectives.
* Proactively develop and impart training on new onboarded or upcoming initiatives for team members.
* Work with Technology and US team in identifying process improvement areas and bring in the culture of automation.
* Drive process optimization, automation, and standardization initiatives to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
* Al fluency \- Demonstrates broad knowledge of AI trends, opportunities, and risks within operations. Supports the implementation of AI driven process improvements, encourages responsible AI adoption within the team, and contributes to efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 4 – 6 years of experience with at least 2 \- 3 years of senior experience in BCM or WAM industry, Exposure to US based asset management or fund administration firm will be an addon.
* Clear communication skills, both written and verbal
* Master’s degree in accounting or finance mandatory. MBA or CA will be good to have.
* Experience with Regulatory Reporting, Validations, Reconciliations, General Adjustment processes would be a plus.
* General understanding of US GAAP, mutual fund regulatory is a plus.
* Should be versatile and have a good understanding of working with Technology platforms/frameworks/tools.
* Actively participate in the selection of new regulatory tools/frameworks and methodologies. Recommend and assist in its implementation.
* Fair understanding of Technology/Framework and Data systems across the WAM sector.
* Functional knowledge: Good knowledge and understanding of WAM domain and deep knowledge of capital market OTC derivative products (Equity, Commodities, Currencies, Rates, Cash and Credit).
* Knowing Risk function deliverables like Key Risks \& Controls and the testing thereof.
* Thorough understanding of different product taxonomies in Regulatory Reporting.
* Understanding BRD would be an added advantage.
* Experience with 1 or more relevant Regulatory Reporting platform.
* Exposure to Python or R tool\-based analytics.
* The candidate must be a highly motivated individual who can handle all levels of complexity in the respective area of operation.
* Should pay attention to detail, proficient in MS applications (Word, Excel, Power Point), excellent analytical skills and must display effective interaction capabilities with various stakeholders.
* The applicant must be comfortable functioning in a fast\-paced environment driven by deadlines.
* Fair knowledge of Capital market instruments.
* US Visa ready is preferred
* Demonstrates ownership, accountability, sound judgment, and a continuous improvement mindset.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a professional with strong Reporting knowledge, excellent analytical \& communication skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, demonstrates ownership and consistently delivers high quality work while meeting deadlines
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.

* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).

* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

* Exposure to SQL scripting, automation tools, and reporting scripts.
* Familiarity with Citrix environments and job scheduling tools.

 The candidate should have hands\-on or working knowledge across SAP TRM and Treasury Management Systems, with exposure to the following functional areas:
   

  

* Foreign Exchange (FX): trade capture, settlement, and valuation support.

title: Senior Associate
description:
**Senior Associate, Accounting Transformation** 




**Role Summary** 




 The Accounting Transformation team partners with clients to improve, remediate, and modernize their accounting operations. As a Senior Associate, you will assess accounting processes, financial data, and reporting practices to identify risks, compliance gaps, and operational inefficiencies. You will lead accounting remediation initiatives, including financial statement clean\-up, account reconciliations, GAAP adjustments, close process documentation, and implementation of scalable accounting practices.
 



 This is a project\-based individual contributor role focused on transforming accounting functions and delivering sustainable outcomes. Success is measured by the quality, accuracy, and completeness of the accounting records, reconciliations, and close processes you leave behind.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Accounting Assessment \& Analysis** 



* Evaluate accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices for compliance with US GAAP.
* Review transaction cycles, including revenue, procure\-to\-pay, payroll, and month\-end close processes.
* Identify accounting risks, reporting issues, control gaps, and operational inefficiencies.
* Assess the quality of the general ledger, chart of accounts, and underlying financial data.
* Document findings and develop remediation plans to address identified issues.



**Accounting Remediation \& Transformation** 



* Perform accounting clean\-up initiatives, including historical corrections, opening balance sheet reconstruction, and cash\-to\-accrual conversions.
* Prepare and post adjusting journal entries supported by appropriate calculations and documentation.
* Apply US GAAP guidance across key accounting areas, including revenue recognition, deferred revenue, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and equity.
* Rebuild or optimize chart of accounts structures and support financial data remediation efforts.
* Research accounting issues and prepare supporting analysis and documentation.



**Reconciliations \& Close Process Development** 



* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding reconciling items.
* Develop and document month\-end close procedures, workflows, and control activities.
* Create workpapers, reconciliation templates, supporting schedules, and audit\-ready documentation.
* Establish repeatable and scalable close processes that can be maintained by ongoing accounting teams.
* Transition completed engagements to Exbo's Controllership team through comprehensive documentation and knowledge transfer.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
* 3 \+ years of accounting experience in public accounting, controllership, accounting operations, or financial reporting.
* Strong knowledge of US GAAP and accounting research methodologies.
* Experience managing full\-cycle month\-end close activities and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Hands\-on experience preparing and posting adjusting journal entries.
* Advanced Excel skills, including large data analysis, pivot tables, lookup functions, and Power Query.
* Strong written communication skills with the ability to create clear process documentation.
* High attention to detail, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to producing accurate, audit\-ready work.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects with limited supervision.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience assessing and redesigning accounting processes and controls.
* Hands\-on experience with QuickBooks Online.
* Experience with accounting clean\-ups, first\-audit readiness projects, or finance transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting US\-based clients and working within US GAAP reporting environments.
* Experience with venture\-backed, private equity\-backed, or high\-growth companies.



**Success in This Role** 



* Deliver accurate, reconciled, and GAAP\-compliant financial records.
* Create sustainable accounting processes and audit\-ready documentation.
* Independently manage engagements from assessment through transition.
* Enable ongoing accounting teams to execute a repeatable and well\-documented close process with confidence.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mind \& Matter India is an integrated digital solutions company with a global presence across Asia and Europe, operating from offices in Kolkata, Bangalore, and Birmingham (UK). The organization connects four key business areas: digital media and marketing, edTech, IT\-enabled services, mobile app and web app development. Over the past 20 years, the company has grown through future\-focused thinking, strategic execution, and wise investment in technology and talent. Mind \& Matter showcases all its businesses under one umbrella brand, emphasizing global capabilities, local focus, and a unified culture. Applicants can explore individual business lines via their LinkedIn company pages to understand the breadth of services and opportunities.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 As a Business Analyst (Customer Solution \& Requirements), you will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will lead customer discovery sessions to uncover operational challenges, translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, and ensure delivered software solutions align directly with customer goals while minimizing scope creep and rework.
 



  





**Role Outcomes** 



* Client onboarding transitions smoothly from signed contract into discovery, scope baselines, and implementation roadmaps.
* Drive and ownership of Client business goals being accurately translated into structured BRDs, FRDs, and SRS documents that drive the end\-to\-end Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Engineering, UI/UX, and QA teams receive production\-ready user stories, system workflows, business logic, and acceptance criteria across all development sprints.
* Scope creep and requirement churn are proactively controlled through formal change management and continuous client communication.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT) achieves fast, structured sign\-offs with direct traceability to the agreed functional specifications.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Discovery \& Client Stakeholder Management** 



* Lead post\-sales requirement workshops, discovery, kickoff sessions, and recurring discovery meetings with client\-side product owners, department heads, and end users.
* Uncover operational challenges, target workflows, and critical success factors; translate contractual scope into realistic functional deliverables.
* Capture detailed meeting minutes, decisions, system dependencies, assumptions, and risk items, obtaining formal client sign\-off.
* Serve as the primary post\-sales functional liaison between the client and internal technical delivery teams.



**Requirement Engineering (BRD, FRD, SRS \& Process Modeling)** 



* Create end\-to\-end
 **Business Requirements Documents (BRD)** 
 detailing business objectives, high\-level scope, user roles, and operational constraints.
* Formulate exhaustive
 **Functional Requirements Documents (FRD)** 
 specifying UI behavior, validations, error handling, system logic, and data structures.
* Develop and maintain
 **Software Requirements Specifications (SRS)** 
 inputs, covering non\-functional requirements, external interfaces, and system interaction constraints.
* Map current client operations (As\-Is) to proposed platform capabilities (To\-Be) using diagrams, process models, and data flow diagrams.
* Maintain a live
 **Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)** 
 linking each business objective through FRD/SRS specifications, sprint backlog items, test cases, and deployment.



**Sprint Execution \& Software Life Cycle (SDLC) Enablement** 



* Own functional grooming throughout the Agile/Scrum delivery lifecycle, breaking down FRDs and SRS items into well\-structured user stories with clear Given\-When\-Then acceptance criteria.
* Drive the Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Reviews to ensure engineering and QA teams understand functional nuances before development begins.
* Provide continuous, in\-sprint functional support to resolve blockers, clarify ambiguous edge cases, and validate work\-in\-progress features.
* Enforce change request procedures by evaluating the scope, cost, sprint velocity, and schedule impact of new client feature requests.



**User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Go\-Live \& Handover** 



* Formulate UAT plans, test scenarios, and acceptance checklists aligned with the signed FRD/SRS.
* Coordinate UAT execution directly with client business users, triaging reported defects to distinguish genuine functional bugs from new out\-of\-scope change requests.
* Guide clients through release demos, product walkthroughs, and end\-user enablement sessions to secure formal project sign\-off.
* Support post\-launch rollout, deployment and functional knowledge transfer to the ongoing client support team.



  





**Expected Deliverables** 



* Client Discovery Agenda, Stakeholder Map, and Meeting Action Logs
* As\-Is \& To\-Be Process Flowcharts and Data Flow Diagrams
* Business Requirements Document (BRD)
* Functional Requirements Document (FRD)
* Software Requirements Specification (SRS) inputs
* Sprint\-Ready User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Edge\-Case Matrices
* Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM)
* Change Request Logs with Scope and Timeline Impact Assessments
* UAT Test Scripts, Defect Logs, and Client Acceptance Sign\-Off Records



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or Engineering.
* **1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or Solution Analyst in a post\-sales, software solution development or SaaS implementation environment.**
* Hands\-on experience drafting formal
 **BRD, FRD, and SRS** 
 documentation, as well as managing sprint backlogs in Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
* Solid understanding of the complete
 **Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)** 
 and Agile/Scrum execution practices.
* Proven track record of independently facilitating workshops and managing client expectations across multiple post\-sales engagements.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and stakeholder presentation skills.
